channel.title: The American Deal: Updates
channel.description: Changes to the National Sovereignty and Resilience Act.

item.title: Open-source re-score: $5.0 trillion in ten-year deficit reduction
item.description: Every tax provision was re-checked with the open-source Tax-Calculator model and IRS income statistics, and the Social Security changes against the Social Security actuaries' published estimates. Social Security tax now applies only to wages above $400,000. A new Section 3412 counts savings only once they are scored or audited.

item.title: One application for every federal benefit (Sec. 3907)
item.description: A single application screens a household for Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, SNAP and health coverage. Shared checks catch duplicate and mistaken payments, with privacy limits and a person reviewing every case. Each program keeps its own rules, and States choose whether to join.

item.title: Fiscal Sustainability Plan and American Resource Fund
item.description: Seven measures save about $305 billion a year at full effect, including spending caps, Medicare drug negotiation, Social Security solvency for future retirees and crop-insurance reform. New oil, gas and offshore-wind royalties go into a permanent fund.

item.title: The whole bill, searchable on one page
item.description: All 40 titles and 261 sections can now be searched and linked section by section, and the homepage shows the complete legislative and fiscal architecture.

item.title: 2026 midterm results: what the new Congress can pass in 2027
item.description: House, Senate and governor results, every flipped seat, and the six NSRA planks with support from both parties that the 120th Congress can move first.
